canonical_data: local working tree, Git history, agent configuration, skills, and exportable coding sessions
current_repo_note: This record covers the MIT-licensed Kilo Code IDE extensions and CLI; Kilo Gateway and Cloud Agent are optional hosted service boundaries and are not classified as open source here.
strengths: IDE and terminal clients share a capable coding-agent workflow with interactive and autonomous operation
Permission rules, MCP, skills, custom agents, session import and export, and Git workflows provide strong operator control
Official integrations cover many cloud, gateway, and local model providers
weaknesses: Auto-approval and remote-control modes materially expand host and account risk when enabled
The optional gateway, cloud-agent, and built-in-provider boundaries are separate services with different source and data-control properties
A rapidly expanding provider and platform surface increases configuration and regression complexity
why_it_matters: A substantial open coding-agent implementation that combines editor and CLI operation with unusually broad provider choice and explicit permission controls.
